name: comp-161
title: Logo Radio Card Group
blurb: Radio cards with app or service logos, one selected at a time.
description: Service selector using card-style radio buttons with embedded SVG logos for apps or platforms.
use_when: Choosing from a set of integrations, apps, or services where logo recognition helps users identify choices.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or when SVG rendering is not reliable.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with proper aria-describedby labels and focus management. SVG logos marked as aria-hidden.
